statement:
Let \(x = \cos\alpha\), \(y = \cos n\alpha\) (\(n \in \mathbb{Z}\)).
i) Prove that to each \(x \in [-1,1]\) corresponds exactly one value of \(y\), so we can write \(y = T_n(x)\). Compute \(T_1(x)\), \(T_2(x)\) and prove \(T_{n+1}(x) = 2xT_n(x) - T_{n-1}(x)\). Conclude \(T_n(x)\) is a polynomial of degree \(n\).
ii) Prove that \(T_n(x)\) has \(n\) distinct roots in \([-1,1]\).

Triangle \(ABC\) with \(I\) the midpoint of \(BC\). \(U\) is a point on line \(BC\). The line through \(C\) parallel to \(AI\) meets \(AU\) at \(E\). The line through \(E\) parallel to \(BC\) meets \(AB\) at \(F\). The line through \(E\) parallel to \(AB\) meets \(BC\) at \(H\). The line through \(H\) parallel to \(AU\) meets \(AB\) at \(K\). Lines \(HK\) and \(FG\) meet at \(T\). Let \(V\) be on \(AU\) such that \(A\) is the midpoint of \(UV\). Show that \(V\), \(T\), \(I\) are collinear.

Let \(ABCD\) be a regular tetrahedron with side \(a\). Take \(E, E'\) on \(AB\), \(F, F'\) on \(AC\), \(G, G'\) on \(AD\) with \(AE=a/6\), \(AE'=5a/6\), \(AF=a/4\), \(AF'=3a/4\), \(AG=a/3\), \(AG'=2a/3\). Compute the volume of \(EFGE'F'G'\) in terms of \(a\) and find the angles between lines \(AB, AC, AD\) and the plane \(EFG\).
